items.q: The first caliph of Islam.
The second caliph, called al-Faruq.
The third caliph, called Dhul-Nurayn.
The fourth caliph, cousin and son-in-law of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The four caliphs together are called this.
The ten Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ given glad tidings of Paradise by name.
The Companion who gave the first call to prayer.
The daughter of our Beloved Master ﷺ, wife of our master 'Ali ﵁.
The two grandsons of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
items.a: Our masters al-Hasan and al-Husayn ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called them "the leaders of the youth of Paradise" (paraphrased).
items.a: Our masters al-Hasan and al-Husayn ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The Companion called "Sayf Allah" (Sword of Allah).
The Persian Companion who searched for the truth across lands.
The Companion called "Amin hadhihi al-Ummah" (trustee of this Ummah).
The wives of our Beloved Master ﷺ are called this.
items.a: Ummahat al-Mu'minin (Mothers of the Believers ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِنَّ)⁩)

items.q: The young Companion who became a great scholar of tafsir.
Our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ servant for about ten years.
The Companion our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called "the most knowledgeable of halal and haram" (paraphrased).
The uncle of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called "Asad Allah" (Lion of Allah).
The Companion who was the first ambassador of Islam, sent to teach Yathrib.
The caliph who had the Qur'an copied into one standard Mushaf and sent copies to the great cities.
The son of our master 'Umar ﵁, famed for following the Sunnah closely.
The Companion whose footsteps our Beloved Prophet ﷺ heard ahead of Him ﷺ in Paradise (meaning).
The ten promised Paradise include the four caliphs, Talhah, al-Zubayr, 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf, Sa'd, Sa'id and this one ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The Companion who was the first to shoot an arrow in the way of Allah.
The commander of the Muslims at al-Qadisiyyah.
The Companion called the "disciple" (hawari) of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
The wealthy Companion who began life in Madinah asking to be shown the market.
The Companion who shielded our Beloved Prophet ﷺ with his hand at Uhud, which was left paralysed.
The Companion who was the scribe of revelation and collected the Qur'an.
The Companion whose recitation our Beloved Prophet ﷺ loved and asked to hear.
The Companion whose voice was compared to the flutes of the family of our master Dawud ﵇.
The poet of our Beloved Master ﷺ who answered the poets of Quraysh.
The Companion who conquered Egypt.
The young Companion appointed by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ to lead an army including senior Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The first wife of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, who supported Him ﷺ with her wealth.
The Mother of the Believers who was a great scholar and narrator.
The Mother of the Believers whose wise advice at al-Hudaybiyah helped the Muslims.
The Mother of the Believers called "Umm al-Masakin" for her charity.
The Ansari leader whose death shook the Throne.
The host of our Beloved Master ﷺ in Madinah, who died near Constantinople.
The first to recite the Qur'an aloud to Quraysh near the Ka'bah, according to Ibn Ishaq ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The Companion of the Ghifar tribe known for zuhd, called "the most truthful in speech".
The caliph who first had the Qur'an gathered into one set of pages after the Battle of Yamamah.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ gave our master 'Ali ﵁ this nickname, finding him lying in the dust.
The Rightly Guided caliphate would last this many years, as our Beloved Prophet ﷺ foretold (meaning).
items.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan al-Tirmidhi (hadith of Safinah)

items.q: The Companion our master 'Umar ﵁ sent to Kufah as teacher and treasurer, who founded its scholarship.
The Companion sent by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ as judge and teacher to Yemen.
The Companion who was the first to be born to the Muhajirun in Madinah.
The mother of 'Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr ﵁.
The Companion who was our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ "keeper of secrets", who knew the names of the hypocrites (meaning).
The Companion of the Ansar given the name "Dhul-Shahadatayn" (his witness counts as two).
The Companion whom the angels ﵈ washed after he fell at Uhud.
The Companion who carried the banner at Uhud until he was martyred.
The Companion, a former slave, whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ adopted before adoption was ended.
The Mother of the Believers whose marriage was ordered in the Qur'an.
The Mother of the Believers who was the daughter of our master 'Umar ﵁.
The Mother of the Believers who gave her turn to our lady 'A'ishah ﵂.
The Mother of the Believers who was the daughter of Abu Sufyan ﵁.
The Mother of the Believers from the Jewish tribe of Banu al-Nadir.
The Mother of the Believers whose marriage freed many of her people, Banu al-Mustaliq.
The last wife our Beloved Master ﷺ married.
The son of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who died as a baby in Madinah.
The mother of our master Ibrahim ﵇, son of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The eldest daughter of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
The four daughters of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
items.a: Our ladies Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِنَّ)⁩

items.q: "Take the Qur'an from four": Ibn Mas'ud, Salim, Mu'adh and this Companion ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ (meaning).
The mother of Anas ibn Malik ﵁, who gave her son to serve our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The poet who came to Madinah to seek pardon and recited the ode "Banat Su'ad".
Our master 'Umar ﵁ was martyred in this year.
Our master Abu Bakr ﵁ died in this year.
Our master 'Uthman ﵁ was martyred in this year.
Our master 'Ali ﵁ was martyred in this year.
Our master Abu Bakr ﵁ fought the wars against those who refused zakat and false prophets, called this.
The false prophet killed at the Battle of Yamamah.
The Companion who killed Musaylimah, with others.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ founded the register of stipends called this.
The city our master 'Umar ﵁ entered peacefully and gave a covenant to its people.
The great battle against the Byzantines in 15 AH / 636 CE.
The great battle against the Persians, around 15 AH / 636 CE.
The Companion who led at Yarmuk, with Khalid ﵁.
The plague in al-Sham in 18 AH / 639 CE in which Abu 'Ubaydah and Mu'adh ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩ died.
The six-man council that our master 'Umar ﵁ named to choose the next caliph.
The Companion who ran the council and chose our master 'Uthman ﵁.
Our master 'Uthman ﵁ bought this well and gave it to the Muslims.
Our master 'Ali ﵁ moved the capital to this city.
The Companion who was the last Companion to die, by the common view.
The last Companion to die in Madinah, by one view.
One of the two women who gave allegiance at the second 'Aqabah, who later fought to defend our Beloved Prophet ﷺ at Uhud.
The keeper of the Ka'bah's key, to whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ returned it on the day Makkah was opened.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ made this Persian Companion governor of al-Mada'in, where he lived very simply.
The last of the ten promised Paradise to die, by the common view.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ announced in Madinah, with tears, the deaths of these three on the day they fell at Mu'tah.
items.a: Zayd, our master Ja'far and 'Abdullah ibn Rawahah ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: Our master Ja'far ﵁ was given this title because he was given two wings in Paradise.
The Companion with whom Zayd ibn Thabit ﵁ found the last verses of Surah al-Tawbah in writing.
The Ansari Companion who travelled for a month to hear a single hadith (meaning).
The Companion called "Habr al-Ummah" (the scholar of the Ummah).
The four 'Abdullahs (al-'Abadilah).
items.a: Ibn 'Umar, Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn al-Zubayr, Ibn 'Amr ibn al-'As ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: The Companion who told a friend, "Sit with us so we can believe for an hour" (meaning).
The Companion who said "I wish I were a tree that is cut down" (meaning) out of fear of Allah.
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi (Abu Dharr's words at the end of the hadith)

items.q: The Companion who was the first in Islam to be called "Amir al-Mu'minin".
The Companion governor of al-Sham under our masters 'Umar and 'Uthman ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩, later caliph.
items.a: Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The Companion who led the first Muslim navy, under our master 'Uthman ﵁.
The Battle of Dhat al-Sawari, around 31 to 34 AH (652 to 655 CE), was this kind of battle.
The woman Companion who sailed in the first naval expedition, as our Beloved Master ﷺ foretold.
The Companion who conquered Persia's capital al-Mada'in.
The Companion who founded Basrah as a garrison town.
The Companion governor of Kufah who founded it as a garrison town.
The Ansari Companion who was the "chief of the Khazraj" (meaning).
The book by Ibn 'Abd al-Barr ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The book by Ibn al-Athir ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The great book on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ by Ibn Hajar al-'Asqalani ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
By Ibn Hajar's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ definition, a Companion met our Beloved Prophet ﷺ believing in Him ﷺ and died in this state.
The number of Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ whose lives are in al-Isabah, roughly.
items.src: al-Isabah (Ibn Hajar); count to be checked

items.q: The cousin of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, son of our master al-'Abbas ﵁, whose grave is honoured in Samarqand.
items.src: al-Isabah (Ibn Hajar); place of death to be checked
